services.name: Birthday Party
services.desc: Birthdays must be scheduled in advance and are booked on a space-available basis. The Riverfront Parking lot across from Mobius will be under construction July 10th - September. Post Street will remain open, but to accommodate construction, the parking lot will be closed. A bus drop-off area serving the playground, Mobius, and Numerica Skate Ribbon and SkyRide is expected to be intermittently impacted but largely remain available. Short pedestrian detours may be needed from time to time. We suggest street parking, River Park Square Parking Garage, or the city lot just north of the Post Street

services.name: Outreach Programs
services.desc: Mobius on the Move comes to you with hands-on, themed activities designed for large group gatherings, schools, classrooms, after school events, family engagement nights, and corporate events. Our education team works with the event coordinator to select activities best suited for your event. Mobius on the Move will host a Science Day at your location. Educators will bring everything needed for STEAM themed hands-on activities. This is a fun way to get a large group involved and excited about science.
